edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Non-fasting triglycerides capture remnant-rich particles after meals, which may better reflect the atherogenic burden people actually carry through the day.
edges.summary: What makes this pair believable is not one flashy paper but the way the literature stacks up: the 2025 Motiwala meta analysis in Cureus already points to high non-fasting triglycerides tracks with higher risk or worse outcomes, and later studies mostly refine the size of the effect rather than overturning it. In practice this reads more like a real risk signal than a one-off finding.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
